critical_code_review_comments: FixRequestButton hardcodes English page-title map (TITLES) and falls back to raw pathname; consider i18n or backend-derived titles for locale support.

FixRequestButton mounts modal in-place via portal-less absolute div with z-[120]; on some layouts the underlying app onboarding 'What's New' modal (z-[80]) can intercept the button trigger — dismiss was needed in Playwright. Consider guarding the header buttons behind What's-New once-per-session close, or move fix-request into a Radix Dialog with proper focus trap.

SupportAccessCard fetches /support/fix-requests unconditionally in useEffect but does not re-poll after a new ticket is filed elsewhere in the app — a small event bus or SWR mutate would keep the 'My fix requests' list fresh.
support_tickets.create_fix_request uses public_rate_limit keyed by tenant only (10/hr) — for a shared salon it might block staff; consider keying by user_id or per-page.
OnboardingIn.checklist typed as Optional[dict]; a Pydantic model with the three booleans would validate keys and prevent typos silently ignored.
